== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[B1 Clanker]]: the PC card image of [[B1 Clanker]] (9 October 2026, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1f401ba5a2c0ecb415b43001cefdb9a2f226553b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual27-Dark/large/b1clanker.gif holotable 1f401ba], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-27.pdf Virtual Set 27 release sheet] (page 1). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026).
